thesis: Seeded DSS needs a seed; leg 313 measured the seed set EMPTY (Hou 2405.10916 fails the screen three ways); leg 334 hard-depends on an answer for its plan clause (c).

screened_object.name: NS3D-DSS-NONAXI-LAMBDA-LARGE
screened_object.description: 3D incompressible NS, non-axisymmetric backward DSS, lambda significantly larger than 1, profile outside L^inf_t L^3; search target is a periodic orbit of the dynamically rescaled flow with period T = 2 log(lambda).

screen_313_three_ways_hou_2405_10916_fai.name: Axisymmetric
screen_313_three_ways_hou_2405_10916_fai.statement: Leg 253's composition (Chae-Wolf Thm 1.1 with the axisymmetric Type-I exclusion) kills axisymmetric DSS outright; Hou 2405.10916 is axisymmetric with swirl.

screen_313_three_ways_hou_2405_10916_fai.name: Generalized, not NS
screen_313_three_ways_hou_2405_10916_fai.statement: Solution-dependent viscosity, effective dimension approx 3.188 (trending to 3 as background viscosity falls). Phase 0's target is standard-viscosity 3D NS.

screen_313_three_ways_hou_2405_10916_fai.name: Stationary, not time-periodic
screen_313_three_ways_hou_2405_10916_fai.statement: It is a nearly self-similar profile -- a fixed point of the rescaled flow -- not a DSS orbit (time-periodic in the rescaled time variable s).

seed_set_empty_finding: THE SEED SET FOR THE SCREENED OBJECT IS EMPTY (leg 313 sec 2): no published numerical DSS candidate for 3D NS survives the NRS/Tsai + axisymmetric screen. Re-confirmed, not re-derived, this leg (writeup/novelty/leg_342.md sec 3): an independent literature pass located no source computing a genuinely time-periodic 3D NS blow-up profile.

cheap_entrance_ban.source: plan_of_record.py BANNED list, entry 3 (verbatim, read via Read tool at plan_of_record.py:807-808, not via a Bash print which this session measured lossy on long strings)
cheap_entrance_ban.text: another DSS CHEAP-ENTRANCE re-ask -- any attempt to obtain a DSS orbit by BIFURCATION OFF A FIXED POINT of a rescaled flow (Hopf or otherwise), inviscid or viscous
cheap_entrance_ban.lift_condition: never -- three independent measured spectral reasons at the fixed point of the gCLM rescaled flow
cheap_entrance_ban.scope_note_from_leg_313: Leg 313 sec 5 flagged, escalated but did not resolve, whether a search SEEDED FROM a known numerical DSS candidate is covered by Entry A (bifurcation off a fixed point) or Entry B (a global search with no fixed point nearby). This leg does not re-litigate that wording question; it applies the ban's literal text -- BIFURCATION OFF A FIXED POINT -- to each candidate's METHOD OF CONSTRUCTION, which is a narrower, uncontested reading that binds regardless of how the wording question resolves.

candidate_seed_sources.method_of_construction: time-marching adaptive-mesh simulation with soft far-field cutoff and viscosity continuation -- not a bifurcation off a fixed point

candidate_seed_sources.method_of_construction: high-order adaptive-mesh time-marching simulation -- not a bifurcation off a fixed point
candidate_seed_sources.verdict: FAILS SCREEN: wrong equation (Euler not NS) in addition to axisymmetric and stationary

candidate_seed_sources.name: Chen 2026 asymptotically self-similar 3D Euler, C^{1,1/3-} velocity (I and II)
candidate_seed_sources.already_flagged_by: leg 313 sec 2 (as one of two 'manufacture rather than find' recipes)
candidate_seed_sources.method_of_construction: a fixed-point (Newton-Kantorovich/contraction) argument around a numerically constructed approximate profile -- read past the search snippet this leg to confirm this is a CERTIFICATION fixed point, not a DYNAMICAL bifurcation off a fixed point of a rescaled flow; the two senses of 'fixed point' are distinct and this one does not trip the ban's literal wording

candidate_seed_sources.name: Kwon-Tsai 2020, bifurcation of self-similar solutions of stationary NS

screen.equation: NS (stationary equations, not the blowup/dynamically-rescaled system)
screen.temporal_structure: seeks discretely-self-similar STEADY solutions via bifurcation from Landau solutions; numerically finds NO bifurcation

candidate_seed_sources.method_of_construction: BIFURCATION FROM LANDAU SOLUTIONS, which are exact stationary (fixed-point) solutions of the similarity system -- this is the literal shape the cheap-entrance ban forbids
candidate_seed_sources.verdict: TRIPLE-DISQUALIFIED: wrong object (steady solutions, not blowup orbits), axisymmetric, AND its method is the exact banned entrance. Recorded as an adverse/cautionary find, not proposed as a route.

candidate_seed_sources.verdict: FAILS SCREEN: wrong equation (proxy model), stationary not time-periodic. Not a seed today, but the MACHINERY is a genuine, demonstrated, working tool, and is the basis for creation path P2 below.

creation_paths.name: Complete Hou's own nu_0-continuation plan (drive c_l(nu_0) -> 1/2, n(nu_0) -> 3)
creation_paths.named_in: arXiv:2405.10916, proposed but not executed there
creation_paths.reasoning: Hou's generalized-dimension machinery is built axisymmetric from the start; the continuation is in viscosity/dimension, not in symmetry-breaking, so completing it clears NONE of screen ways 1 or 3 -- at best it approaches screen way 2 (dimension -> 3). Its natural completion is a stationary axisymmetric fixed point of the true-viscosity rescaled NS flow. The obvious next step -- perturb that fixed point to find a nearby DSS orbit -- is BIFURCATION OFF A FIXED POINT OF A RESCALED FLOW, the cheap-entrance ban's own literal text. This path is a dead end whose most natural continuation is banned outright, not a costable route.
creation_paths.cost_note: Not costed: the path does not terminate at a screen-passing seed, and its natural next move is pre-banned.

creation_paths.name: Retarget Hou's own PINN/KAN machinery (arXiv:2506.19243) from the 2D Boussinesq proxy to the genuine non-axisymmetric 3D NS DSS ansatz
creation_paths.status: OPEN -- the only creation path this leg finds that is not structurally blocked
creation_paths.reasoning: Reuses leg 313/260's five-module cost floor. Four of the five required modules (3D non-axisymmetric NS solver in similarity variables; 3D Leray/Biot-Savart, formulation-specific per leg 332's finding; unbounded-domain discretisation carrying leg 313's measured algebraic far-field + log-periodic block, 1414.9x radial resolution penalty; phase/gauge bordering condition per leg 260/313's lineage) are UNCHANGED by the seeding choice. The fifth module (periodic-orbit search) is REPLACED, not added: a PINN/KAN training loop enforcing V(y,s) = V(y,s+S_0), S_0 = 2 log(lambda), lambda trainable/output, adapted from 2506.19243's unbounded-domain sampling and optimization techniques, in place of a from-scratch global search or a local Newton-Krylov continuation. This is a genuinely new construction -- no located paper trains a PINN against a time-periodicity constraint for NS or Euler -- but it reuses published, demonstrated unbounded-domain PINN techniques rather than inventing them.
creation_paths.cost_method: five-module floor at this leg's live legs/module rate (342 legs / 49 modules indexed by capabilities.py = 6.98 legs/module; 5 x 6.98 = 34.9, same order as leg 313's ~33-leg estimate for the seeded Newton-Krylov route)
creation_paths.cost_note: The floor barely moves with the seeding CHOICE (Hou's late-stage-mesh cutoff vs PINN pretraining): it is set by the four modules unaffected by seeding, not by the seed mechanism itself. This is a shape-of-price finding, not a claim of accuracy on the 35.

gate_branch_text: the measured statement that none exists today plus what would create one, named and costed
consequence_for_leg_334: 334's plan clause (c) asks for a concrete non-empty seeding strategy OR the measured statement that none exists yet and what would create one -- this leg supplies exactly the second branch, with P1 explicitly ruled out (not merely priced) and P2 named and costed at ~35 legs, same order as the route's other build-floor estimates.
